What is "Shokudo"
Shokudo culture refers to the casual dining experience associated with shokudo, or informal eateries in Japan. These establishments offer a variety of affordable, home-style meals, making them popular among students, workers, and families. The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting, encouraging diners to enjoy a quick meal or a leisurely gathering with friends and loved ones. Menus typically feature an array of dishes, including sushi, rice bowls, noodles, and seasonal ingredients, reflecting regional and cultural influences. With a focus on reasonable pricing, shokudo are accessible to a wide audience and often emphasize the use of fresh, local ingredients, celebrating the flavors of the region. Additionally, some shokudo incorporate elements from other cuisines, showcasing Japan's openness to culinary diversity. Overall, shokudo culture embodies a warm, inclusive approach to dining that values both nourishment and community. 

In Shokudo Underworld, we bring you the most immersive shokudo experience imaginable!  Whether you are a student struggling with tests, assignments, and future challenges, a worker completing an infinite amount of tasks, or a group of friends or families looking for a unique way to bond, our game invites you to dive into a whimsical kitchen like no other. It is fun for everyone and perfect for players of all ages!

Join our community and connect with fellow chefs and share your best cooking moments!

Happy Cooking!
Miluku Inc.

notes.title: Game Update: Controller Support Now Available! 🎮
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079619/1999cbd161f2acce29d4592c0581672bddac46e6.jpg
Hey, chefs!

It’s the moment we’ve all been waiting for (drumrolls)! We’re excited to announce that our latest update finally introduces full controller support for Shokudo Underworld. We know many of you have been asking for this feature, and we’re thrilled to deliver it. 
What’s Included:

 Full Controller Mapping: Use any standard controller to navigate menus, control your character, and enjoy the game just as you would with a keyboard and mouse.
 Improved Compatibility: Support for various controllers, including Xbox, PlayStation, Steam Deck, and other gamepads. Just connect your controller to your PC and launch Shokudo Underworld, and you're good to go! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079619/4e72f214c4fabfc23e1611e1a9d72a713fefaf87.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079619/4cbb87123235b52603d896ccf072090daf8b1b66.png

New Feature:

 We have added a skip option for the opening cutscene, allowing players to jump right into the game. 

We can’t wait for you to experience Shokudo Underworld in a whole new way! As always, we appreciate your feedback, so feel free to share your thoughts on the new controller support. 

Happy gaming!
Miluku Inc.

Challenge Your Foodie Palate
Shokudo Underworld is a 2.5D restaurant management game where you play as a corporate worker serving food to Underworld customers. Use a variety of strange underground ingredients to create delicious and bizarre dishes that will tantalize your customers' taste buds. As you earn more salary, you can pray to the gods to unlock new skills and tools, which will help you upgrade your restaurant and provide even better service.

Feature Spotlights

 The Mystical Shokudo: Serve up delicious dishes on time to earn tips, experience, and cute gacha prizes. Meanwhile, make wishes to the gods and harness their divine power to upgrade your restaurant and attract more customers!
 The Quirky and Eerie Art: Delight in the most “adorable” cartoon characters and immerse yourself in an authentic restaurant environment with a mystical atmosphere.
 The Enchanting Music: Experience an original soundtrack with Japanese shokudo themes that transport you to a magical world.

Game Lore
The story unfolds with a depressed corporate worker who meets his untimely end in a restaurant accident. In his final moments, he dreams of one last taste of his favorite ramen, hoping to find it in the afterlife. But instead of a heavenly feast, he is met with a surprising twist: he is reincarnated as a corporate worker once more, but this time in the depths of the Underworld.

In this new realm, he runs a bustling shokudo for Underworld residents. He must source rare, magical ingredients from a farm inhabited by mythical creatures and enchanted vegetables, then turn them into dishes for his otherworldly customers. Overwhelmed by tasks and challenges, he needs your help to turn his misfortune into success. Will you assist him in the afterlife?

Tips and Tricks

 Zoom zoom! Gotta run up and down quickly. Better carry an extra backpack too.
 The more variety you have in the food menu, the more experience you gain. However, you need to carefully time your service and gather ingredients.
 What da cat doing? Rub its belly and see what happens.

About Our Team - Miluku Inc.
Freshly brewed games, straight from the source!

We are a new indie game studio founded by four passionate university graduates. While none of us studied game design, our shared dream of crafting a fantastical world inspired us to start this studio, and the excitement of bringing our vision to life continues to fuel our motivation.
